free_text: The patient is a 69-year-old male with a high PSA of 27.0 ng/mL and a cT3a prostate cancer, confirmed by an mpMRI PI-RADS 5 lesion showing extracapsular extension. The documented Gleason score is 3+4 (ISUP Grade Group 2). Management assessment is pending clinical review to determine individual treatment benefit and patient preferences, balancing potential oncologic control against treatment side effects.
